title: Sunday · the flyer photo
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The photographed flyer, blurry, lettered over, pinned at the end of twenty-one; the strip's Sunday looks at the change from paper to pixel on a shingle wall and says nothing.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the flyer wall, twenty-one long, the last one visibly a printout: the blur, the inkjet banding, the hand lettering crisp over it.

image.prompt: a shingle wall with a long row of hand-drawn crab flyers ending in a blurry inkjet printout with crisp hand lettering over it, no words legible

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 2: the printout, close: the blur, the lettering's ink sitting on top of it like it's from another world.

image.prompt: close on a blurry inkjet printout of a child's crab drawing with crisp hand-lettered capitals over it, no words legible

panels.name: Blur

panels.composition: Tier 3: the 1998 flyer at the other end, close: paper, sun, a hand. Held.

image.prompt: close on a sun-bleached hand-drawn paper flyer with one enormous crab, no words legible

panels.name: Paper

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: Paper to pixel on a shingle wall.
